Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden embeddings latency spike in prod — initial root cause

Quick triage notes: pulled traces (https://redwood-internal/trace/abcd1234) and perf counters from us-west pool. Observations:
- Catalog v20260903 introduced variant "embed-256x-large" with updated tokenizer/positioning that increases average sequence length by ~2.1x for several customer prompts.
- That variant was marked compatible with our cuDNN-fallback path; for sequence lengths >256 we drop into an unfused attention kernel that shows dramatically higher tail latency.
- FastApp's traffic has a high percentage of batched short sequences, but with one classifier prep step that created a long prefix; the new variant interacts poorly with KV cache alignment leading to repeated cache reloads (see traces).

Mitigation options:
1) immediate rollback of the catalog entry (affects all customers who picked the new variant) — likely takes 20–30 min to propagate.
2) server-side forced pin for FastApp: route their calls to prior variant (embed-256x) — can be done ASAP per-tenant.
3) short-term adaptive throttling + increased retry with jitter on client side (not ideal).

I recommend option 2 for speed + option 1 in parallel if rollback testing is green. I'll prepare the patch to pin FastApp and a rollback runbook.

Connor O'Brien
SRE, Runtime Performance | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
